name: HMS Prince of Wales
description: HMS Prince of Wales, the second ship of the King George V class battleships, was one of the main battleships of the British Navy during World War II. It was built in 1937, with a length of 227.1 meters, a width of 31.3 meters, and a full load displacement of 40,580 tons. In 1941, during the interception mission, they fought against the German Bismarck and severely damaged each other. In August 1941, the Atlantic Charter was signed on the ship, marking the formation of the anti-fascist alliance between Britain and the United States. On December 10, 1941, it was sunk by the Japanese Air Force during the Malayan Naval War, ending its short but extraordinary service career.
